scope: Gate 13R-PR2 S48/H48 formal raw-data acquisition and every later analysis attempt

phase1RawAcquisition.immutablePayloadDefinition: all schedule-owned block directories and their block/sample/summary/workload-result evidence; mutable orchestration status and later analysis outputs are excluded

postCollectionRawCommitRecovery.provenRawContractViolationAction: stop, retain evidence, and require separate user decision; never automatically rerun Unity

phase2Analysis.failedAttemptPolicy: retain failed attempt; version the analysis implementation; rerun tests; analyze the same frozen raw data in a new attempt

failureClassification.duringMeasuredSampleOrBlock: existing fail-closed formal acquisition policy applies; stop before the next block
failureClassification.afterAllUnityBlocksToolingFailure: freeze collected payload; do not rerun Unity; perform separately versioned read-only raw-commit audit recovery
failureClassification.provenMissingCorruptOrContractInvalidRaw: do not declare RAW-DATA-COMPLETE; require separate user authorization for any new experiment
